versions.changelog:
- Added documentation for "sovereign" mode, enabling agents to swap, sell, collect, and be paid directly by setting `PIPRAIL_MODE=sovereign` and `PIPRAIL_MAX_PER_SWAP`.
- Described six new tools available in sovereign mode (`piprail_quote_swap`, `piprail_swap`, `piprail_sell`, `piprail_collect`, `piprail_earnings`, `piprail_wallet`), noting they are appended in addition to the existing eight tools.
- Clarified that receiving payments is possible with no wallet key, making agent collection secure on machines that cannot spend.
- Removed redundant file skill-card.md from the repository.
8th tool: piprail_verify_receipt — re-verify a payment receipt against the chain, wallet-free (verifiable receipts in @piprail/mcp 0.9.0)
Surface discover filters (category/asset/reliability, sort) + register category/tags for findability (SDK 2.1.x).
Surface the gasless 'exact' rail (zero-gas buyer on EVM+Solana) + lead the description with read-only/no-key. Tracks @piprail/mcp 0.6.1 / SDK 2.0.2.
Multi-chain mode: document PIPRAIL_CHAINS (one wallet per chain — the agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for, one shared budget) + the token-units cap note. Wraps @piprail/mcp 0.5.0.
Docs: add follow/star community links (GitHub · @piprailhq) to Learn more; aligns with @piprail/mcp 0.4.1 (read-only mode documented).
Read-only is the default config (no key); a wallet key is a separate opt-in only for paying. Make it unmistakable: PipRail needs no API key.
Read-only by default: runs with NO key (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); the self-custodial wallet key is needed only to pay. No API key, ever.
Simplify the slug to 'piprail' — install is now 'clawhub install piprail' (old slug redirects).
Payment-forward description (it's a crypto payment wallet, not a data/API skill); drop API/key phrasing.

Move to the @piprail org publisher (shows the PipRail identity, not a personal handle); drop the misleading 'API key required' badge — the wallet key is documented in the body, not declared as a service credential.
Rename to piprail-openclaw-skill (distinguishes the OpenClaw integration from upcoming Vercel/ElizaOS); correct install instructions.
Correct the install slug to 'piprail' (clawhub install piprail); align the folder to the skill name.

Initial release — budget-bound x402 payment wallet for OpenClaw agents across every major chain (EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, NEAR, Sui, Aptos, Algorand, Stellar, XRPL). No facilitator, no fee, self-custodial; a hard spend cap the model cannot exceed.
